title: feat(core): migrate instantsearch.js to instantsearch-core
body:
**Summary**

migrate instantsearch constructor, index widget, connectors, utils, and remaining types from .js to instantsearch-core.

**Result**

Everything should work as is, minus a couple deprecated changes removed here to make migration simpler (eg. \_\_hitIndex)

BREAKING CHANGE: \_\_hitIndex is no longer populated
